content.what_it_is: Interactive MATLAB movie generator for vessel-island eta outputs. It reads start/end frame numbers, loads depth.txt solely to establish grid dimensions, constructs 2 m coordinates (L3-L21), opens movie.avi at 10 fps, loads each numbered eta file, replaces values above 10 with NaN, renders a fixed-range pcolor frame, and writes it to the video (L31-L72).
entities: eta output directory fdir defined at L3
depth directory fdep defined at L4
variable mask loaded from eta_00001 at L6
interactive frame bounds ns and ne defined at L8-L9
depth array dep1 loaded at L11
grid dimensions n and m defined at L15
origins x0/y0 and spacing dx defined at L16-L18
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L20-L21
VideoWriter object vidObj defined at L31
Figure handle h defined at L35
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L38-L39
frame loop index num defined at L44
formatted suffix fnum defined at L46
eta loaded at L47 and masked at L50
captured frame currframe defined at L67

equations.ref: y coordinates from depth rows, using dx
replace eta values over 10 with NaN

calls: load at L6, L11, and L47
unresolved: Likely copy/paste spacing defect across L17-L21: no dy parameter is defined and y uses dx. This silently forces square cells even if the intended y spacing differs.

The variable mask loaded from eta_00001 at L6 is never used and is not a mask; dry/invalid regions are instead inferred solely by eta>10 at L50, which can also discard legitimate values above that threshold.
Cross-file shape assumption across L11-L21 and L47-L56: plotting coordinates are sized from depth.txt, while each eta file is not checked for matching dimensions.

Interactive ns/ne at L8-L9 are not validated as ordered nonnegative integers. ns>ne yields no frames, while invalid numbers generate missing/ill-formed filenames; no diagnostic occurs before opening the writer at L31-L33.
MATLAB pcolor at L56 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present.
